title: Substack Posts Scraper input

startUrls.title: Substack publication or post URLs
startUrls.description: One or more Substack publication URLs. Accepts publication roots (e.g. 'https://platformer.substack.com' or custom domain 'https://www.lennysnewsletter.com') and single post URLs ('https://.../p/some-post'). Each publication is paginated up to maxPosts. NOT a keyword search input — this actor scrapes by publication URL.

url.title: URL
url.description: A Substack publication or post URL, e.g. https://platformer.substack.com

maxPosts.title: Max posts per publication
maxPosts.description: Hard cap on the number of posts scraped and billed per publication. Each post counts as one billable result. Defaults to 50. Set lower for cheap test runs.

includeBodyHtml.title: Include full body HTML
includeBodyHtml.description: When true (default), fetches each post's detail page to capture the complete article HTML. Public posts return full HTML; paid posts return metadata + paywall signal only. Adds one HTTP request per post.

includeBodyText.title: Include plain text body
includeBodyText.description: When true (default), includes a plain-text version of the article body (derived from the HTML). Public posts return full text; paid posts return the teaser only. Disable to reduce payload size.

publishedAfter.title: Published after (ISO date)
publishedAfter.description: Optional ISO 8601 date or datetime. Only posts published on or after this date are returned, e.g. '2026-01-01' or '2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'. Leave empty for no lower bound.

publishedBefore.title: Published before (ISO date)
publishedBefore.description: Optional ISO 8601 date or datetime. Only posts published on or before this date are returned. Leave empty for no upper bound.

audience.title: Audience filter
audience.description: Filter posts by paywall audience. 'all' (default) returns every post; 'free' returns only free posts; 'paid' returns only paid/paywalled posts (metadata + teaser).

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
